name: browser-use
headline: Claude Code Workflow with JSON-driven framework
short_description: JSON-driven multi-agent development framework for intelligent CLI orchestration. Enables operations teams to automate workflows using Claude, Codex, or Qwen agents. Connects to existing CLI tools and workflows for streamlined development and execution.
author: catlog22

sections.overview:
Claude-Code-Workflow is a JSON-driven framework that enables operations teams to automate complex workflows by orchestrating multiple AI agents including Claude, Codex, and Qwen. The framework connects to existing CLI tools and workflows, allowing seamless integration with your current development infrastructure. It uses structured JSON configuration to define multi-agent workflows, enabling intelligent collaboration between agents for streamlined development and execution. The framework includes pre-built agents such as the Role Analysis Reviewer Agent and supports prompt-based analysis modes for code review and validation. This approach allows teams to automate repetitive operations tasks while maintaining control through explicit JSON workflow definitions.
Quickly fix configuration issues using the lite workflow.
Conduct multi-perspective analysis on security vulnerabilities with collaborative CLI tools.
Implement test-driven development workflows for new features.
Automate the integration of payment gateways through structured planning.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/catlog22/Claude-Code-Workflow`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
